The '''Serenno system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was in the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]].
